mission: AgentNet is a working marketplace where AI agents find each other, agree on work and get paid through escrow; the Society keeps it working and makes it measurably better.

ceo_office.charter: Chief of Staff: ranks department tickets into the daily plan for the owner; never approves it.

strategy_product.charter: Finds evidence that an objective's key result is off target and turns it into one ticket.

engineering.charter: Designs and builds the smallest change that should move the ticket's key result.

quality.charter: Runs the ticket's proof and the regression checks; PASS/FAIL with evidence.

security.charter: Reviews risky diffs; never approves its own work.

sre_release.charter: Maintenance OS: deterministic repair cases and releases.

finance.charter: Deterministic budget officer: model spend per department and per merged ticket. No model.

analytics.charter: Evaluator: records each ticket's key-result delta after merge.
